title: Kern River Sequoia RV Resort

services.name: New Cabins
services.desc: Our cozy and comfortable cabins sleep up to 6 people with two separate bedrooms and a full bathroom. *Master bedroom includes a king-sized bed with memory foam mattress, a flat screen TV, and armoire for storage and clothes. Our second sleep area features a set of bunk beds. The front room includes a second TV, dining table, and a comfortable futon that folds out to be a double bed. Kitchen provides dishes, flatware, some basic kitchen utensils, microwave oven, a refrigerator, crock pot, electric skillet, toaster, and Keurig coffee pot.
